meaning:
στασιαστής
(στασιάζω, to stir up sedition, Jdth.7:15, 2Ma.4:30 2Mac 14:6 *)
= Att.. στασιώτης,
a rebel, revolutionist, one who stirs up sedition: Mrk.15:7 (FlJ, al.).†
συ-στασιαστής, -οῦ, ὁ,
a fellow-rioter: Mrk.15:7, Rec.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: them that had made insurrection with him

elsewhere.note: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.
